findings.body: This branch defines only the clarification presentation shape; it does not implement pending-request continuation, scope retention, capacity/expiry, authorization rechecks, cancellation, or restart outcomes required by done-when item 3. The approved task allocation assigns those behaviors and their end-to-end proofs to MEMORY, GRAPH, API, STREAM, CLIENT, and REGRESSION.
findings.title: Later: MEMORY/GRAPH/API/STREAM/CLIENT/REGRESSION must prove clarification lifecycle
